name: cn.narracore/screenplay-formatter
title: Narracore Screenplay Formatter
description: Screenplay toolkit over MCP: format to print-ready PDF, deterministic stats (scenes / character table), scene shootability diagnosis (AI cites evidence, server scores), Fountain conversion, and video-prompt scaffolds with free drift-proof checks (dialogue verbatim lock, cut-point handoff). Chinese/English/mixed. One free screenplay/day; packs from $1.49 — one use covers one screenplay for 24 hours across all tools.
